description: This file defines the BookService class, which provides methods to search for books, retrieve detailed information, fetch chapter content, request downloads, check download status, and poll for download completion from a backend API. It integrates model classes such as Book, BookDetail, and Chapter, and interacts with an ApiClient singleton for network operations.

classes.name: BookService
classes.description: A service class that handles book discovery, fetching detailed book information, chapter content retrieval, and download management interactions with a backend API.

methods.name: searchBooks
methods.description: Performs a search for books matching the query, returning a list of Book objects.

methods.name: getBookDetail
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific book, including its chapters.

methods.name: getChapterContent
methods.description: Fetches the HTML or content of a specific chapter in a book.

methods.name: requestDownload
methods.description: Requests the backend API to initiate a download for a specified book and format.

methods.name: getDownloadStatus
methods.description: Checks the current status of a download job.

methods.name: pollDownloadStatus
methods.description: Continuously polls the download status until completion or error, yielding status updates.
